scope: One-step original hip convergence discriminator; no production adoption or physical/native/repeat/performance qualification.
protocol: Bounded algebraically identical objective safeguard correction. Replace rounded total-objective comparison in spherical motor and contact ball projection by d dot (cdot+K(feasible_old-old)) + 0.5 d dot Kd, d=candidate-feasible_old. No change to physical parameters, impulse domains, metric solve, bisection count or wave stopping. Before GPU,512seeded2D/3D SPD cases, condition up to1e6, zero radius/infeasible old/near-stationary boundaries: compare float32 delta formula against independent float64 quadratic difference using exact float32 inputs. Error bound32eps times absolute arithmetic term sum; sign must agree outside bound; selected value may not increase beyond that bound; bound excess <=4eps relative. Preserve rejected/uncertain cases. Then one original hip step,4substeps,1e-5velocity/cache/twoquiet/128cap unchanged; stop expansion on any failed phase. No physical acceptance from numerical control. Restore source and normal library.

preserved_control_failure.reason: JSON writer rejected NumPy float32 in report after controls. Convert report scalars without changing numerical tests.

 dd=x.astype(float)-fo.astype(float);Ad=A.astype(float);rhd=rhs.astype(float);od=o.astype(float);fd=fo.astype(float);true=float(dd@(rhd+Ad@(fd-od))+.5*dd@Ad@dd);g=rhd-Ad@od;direct=float(.5*x.astype(float)@Ad@x.astype(float)+g@x.astype(float)-(.5*fd@Ad@fd+g@fd));algebra=abs(true-direct)
 # Absolute operation scale also includes feasible-old subtraction and each matrix product's cancellation.
 scale=float(abs(dd)@(abs(rhd)+abs(Ad)@(abs(fd)+abs(od)))+.5*abs(dd)@abs(Ad)@abs(dd));bound=32*eps*scale+1e-30;error=abs(float(delta)-true);assert error<=bound,(i,error,bound)
 assert algebra<=1e-10*(1+abs(direct)+np.linalg.norm(g)*np.linalg.norm(fd)),(i,algebra)
 if abs(true)>bound:assert (delta>0)==(true>0),(i,delta,true,bound)
 selected=fo if delta>0 else x;increase=0 if delta>0 else true;assert increase<=bound
 excess=max(0,float(np.linalg.norm(selected.astype(float)))-float(radius));assert excess<=4*eps*max(float(radius),1e-30)
 rows.append(dict(case=i,dimension=n,radius=float(radius),condition=float(np.linalg.cond(K.astype(float))),true_delta=true,float32_delta=float(delta),error=error,bound=bound,selected_increase=increase,bound_excess=excess,decision_resolved=bool(abs(true)>bound)))
result=dict(status='controls-pass',cases=len(rows),maximum_error_bound_ratio=max(r['error']/r['bound'] for r in rows),resolved_decisions=sum(r['decision_resolved'] for r in rows),rows=rows);(p/'controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,default=float));print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='rows'},indent=2,default=float))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,hashlib,json,sys
arm=sys.argv[1]
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
shader=Path('shaders/physics/solve.wgsl')
original=(root/'original-solve.wgsl').read_bytes()
assert shader.read_bytes()==original
try:
 shader.write_bytes((root/f'{arm}-solve.wgsl').read_bytes())
 with (root/f'{arm}-build.log').open('w') as log:
  r=subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release','--lib','--features','replay-diagnostics'],env=__import__('os').environ|{'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'1'},stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (root/f'{arm}-build-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit':r.returncode}))
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
 shutil.copy2('target/release/libgpu_physics.a',root/f'{arm}-libgpu_physics.a')
finally:
 shader.write_bytes(original)
 (root/f'{arm}-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_restored':shader.read_bytes()==original,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()}))

env.update(RAIN_CELL_ROW='3',RAIN_CELL_COLUMN='9',RAIN_REPLAY_BASE='3907',RAIN_REPLAY_STATE=str(p/'hip-initial.txt'),RAIN_REPLAY_LIMITS='1',RAIN_REPLAY_HEALTH='1',RAIN_REPLAY_COLLISIONS='1',GPU_PHYSICS_LIVE_CONTACT_ORDER='0',WGPU_BACKEND='vulkan',GPU_PHYSICS_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR=str(Path.home()/'.cache/box3d-gpu-physics/pipelines'),GPU_PHYSICS_STATE_TRACE=str(out/'trace.jsonl'))

 values.append([f(x) for x in j['spring_angular_impulse']+j['motor_angular_impulse']+j['angular_impulse'][:2]]);caps.append(f(j['weld_linear_impulse'][1]))

for i,(count,vel,imp) in enumerate(zip(*values)):
 assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in [count,vel,imp]) and int(count)==count and 2<=count<=128 and vel>=0 and imp>=0
 passes.append({'substep':i//2,'phase':'bias' if i%2==0 else 'relax','iterations':int(count),'last_velocity_change':vel,'last_impulse_change':imp,'last_change_below_threshold':max(vel,imp)<=1e-5})

pack=lambda x:struct.pack('<'+'f'*len(x),*x);assert set(initial)==set(getters) and all(pack(initial[k])==pack(getters[k]) for k in initial)

assert caps[0]>=sum(not p['last_change_below_threshold'] for p in passes)
